def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    borrowed_amount_jpy = 1_000_000
    borrowing_rate = 0.005
    investment_rate = 0.05
    exchange_rate_brl_per_jpy = 0.05

    invested_amount_brl = borrowed_amount_jpy * exchange_rate_brl_per_jpy

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    investment_ending_balance = invested_amount_brl * (1 + investment_rate)
    borrowed_amount_ending_jpy = borrowed_amount_jpy * (1 + borrowing_rate)
    borrowing_cost_brl = borrowed_amount_ending_jpy * exchange_rate_brl_per_jpy

    profit_brl = investment_ending_balance - borrowing_cost_brl

    # return answer
    return round(profit_brl)
